$comment: Always-loaded agent-doc budget RATCHET (tempdoc 620 Move 3, extended for Codex in tempdoc 920). Codex loads AGENTS.md; Claude loads CLAUDE.md + .claude/rules/*.md. This caps each harness's unconditional context. Each file's size must stay <= its ceiling, and the ceiling only ratchets DOWN: run `node scripts/ci/check-always-loaded-budget.mjs --rebalance` after content migrates out (Moves 1/2: generation, the consult-register, skill/doc relocation) to shrink the ceiling to the new size. A net-new always-loaded addition that regrows a file past its ceiling fails the check — UNLESS the growth is justified and declared via `node scripts/ci/check-always-loaded-budget.mjs --bump <file> --reason "<why>"`, which raises that ceiling to current size and records the reason in `bumps` (tempdoc 618 §13: an explicit, auditable raise, not silent ceiling surgery). ~tokens = bytes/4. Wiring: WIRED into .github/workflows/ci.yml (public-claims job) as of tempdoc 799 — before that it ran nowhere and the set drifted 18.5% past ceiling across four sessions that each logged it red. Kept as a CI lint rather than a kernel gate per 582 R3 (extend the proven meta-gate, do NOT author a new kernel gate).
